mechanism: Rifampin is a potent inducer of CYP3A4 and CYP2C9, significantly increasing carbamazepine metabolism and clearance, while carbamazepine also induces rifampin metabolism, reducing both drugs' efficacy.
action: Avoid concurrent use if possible; if necessary, monitor carbamazepine and rifampin levels closely, increase carbamazepine dose by 25-50%, and reassess seizure control and tuberculosis treatment response regularly.
